text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text: @gideon.sato: The channel shows your first report at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you posted that both inbound gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant. The only guard detail in the channel is from that same message: the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when Mateo posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted both lanes working at 11:07 AM. The channel doesn't record what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03, so if you need more than that, check with the guard or the gate logs.
